notes.title: Soundtrack and Android are here! ... And an Award Opportunity!
notes.content:
[h1]Android[/h1]
For all of you Android users, we are now launched on [b]Google Play[/b]! After having to go through such a long process to get here, it's very awesome to be able to share it with everyone. You can download it here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HowlinHugs.TheWereCleaner

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]
The [b]soundtrack [/b]is also finally available for free here on Steam! Our composer worked hard to tidy up the tracks, so we hope that you enjoy! And take a glance at the track names-- we definitely had a good time coming up with them.❤️https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461070/The_WereCleaner_Soundtrack/

[h1]Audience Award![/h1]
We've also become a finalist for the Independent Game Festival's (IGF) Best Student Game category! 

[h2]Help us potentially get the [b]Audience Choice Award [/b]by voting for us here:[/h2] https://informa-tech.formstack.com/forms/27th_annual_independent_games_festival_audience_award

Voting ends tomorrow, January 31st! and we promise that we won't hold it against you if you don't vote for us 😉 .... but we'd love you if you did ✨ ❤️ XD. Thank you all so much for your support-- we appreciate the love that you've all given us.

notes.title: The WereCleaner PLUSHIE!
notes.content:
[h1]The WereCleaner Kyle and Daryl Pre-Orders![/h1]
We're back with more plushie pre-orders, but this time we've also got DARYL! We're going to do this through pre-order with about a 3 month turnaround. Get an 8.5 inch plush of Kyle for $20 plus a separate shipping price! Or, get an 11" tall Daryl for $23, plus shipping. Or... get a complete set!

[h2]Shop Link[/h2]
This will be our third batch of Kyle Plushies along with our first batch of Daryl. We will keep the Pre-Order open for 3 weeks starting on NOVEMBER 30TH 12PM PST, ending on DECEMBER 21ST 12PM PST or until we reach 500 plushies ordered for each character.
[url=https://thewerecleaner.bigcartel.com/]Pre-Order here![/url]


[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Our Android release is COMING, we swear it! We've made very significant progress in shipping it-- fine tuning the last bugs and ready to try to get past Google Play's developer recognition process once more! Our composer is also almost ready to share the soundtrack with you all! We're making versions of the tracks which have proper endings and don't only loop, so keep your eyes peeled for that too!

See you soon, folks
[b]The WereCleaner Team[/b]

notes.title: Mac Release!
notes.content:
That’s right, it’s update time! We’ve been hard at work on these additions, so read on!

[h1]Mac Release[/h1]
The WereCleaner is now fully playable on Mac! This version has feature parity with the Windows version and will receive future updates at the same time. Both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs are supported, although we recommend at least an M1 Mac for the best experience.

Sadly, you cannot play the game on Steam due to Mac's Permissions, but we've released it here on the Mac App Store!
▶️ https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-werecleaner/id6478448519 ◀️ 

Android is now our next thing that we'll be working on, so I ask that you please be patient with us while we try to sort out the issues we've been having with it ❤️ 

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Android, first of all! Our team is hard at work on the closed beta (which, again, you can join on the [url=https://discord.gg/kp9hm5jB4Z]Discord![/url]). We've got comics coming out on our Twitter: https://x.com/The_WereCleaner and Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3BodZBaHAhVUmV4Fwjn1NQ

We've got a merch store through RedBubble: https://www.redbubble.com/people/thewerecleaner/shop?anchor=profile&asc=u

And a tip jar if you want to support us! https://tiptopjar.com/thewerecleaner

More Stuff is on the horizon folks, so stay tuned!

[h1]Update 2[/h1]
This game update addresses lots of bugs, big and small. In many cases, these fixes improve the experience for both Mac and Steam Deck players! Wow! 

[url=https://discord.gg/kp9hm5jB4Z]Many of these bugs were also found and reported in our Discord community, which happens to be a super sick place that you can join right now![/url]

[h2]Features[/h2]
- Adjusted UI Screens to support taller aspect ratios
- Added additional names to the credits
- Added trash ball counter to mobile (shoutout to Jay in Discord)

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where tool key prompts would eventually desync
- Improved resolution scaling options
- Fixed various visual glitches with dropdown menus
- Fixed incorrect mess bar offsets during gameplay
- Fixed a visual bug where the power washer would break in the elevator
- Fixed a visual bug with an endgame reward
- Fixed an issue where NPCs in Level 1 would get stuck while carrying a trash ball
- Fixed an issue where achievement progress was lost between updates
- fixed fish

See you soon, buds
[b]The WereCleaner Team[/b]

notes.title: Thank You for Week 1!
notes.content:
It has been 1 week since The WereCleaner released and we have been blown away by all the love and support. This game has been a passion project for almost a year, so it is incredible to see so many people play the game and share their experiences with us. Thank you, thank you, thank you!

[h1]The WereCleaner Community Discord[/h1]
We've made a public community Discord server! Stop on by to watch speedruns, hear about the latest updates and lore drops, chat with the devs [strike]and kill your coworkers.[/strike]

[url=https://discord.gg/kp9hm5jB4Z]Join the Discord Server![/url]

[h1]Update 1 - Fixes, Fixes, Fixes![/h1]
Our first game update is live! Nothing crazy has been added for now (let us cook...) but we've addressed many small issues.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a 'Delete Save Data' option in the Settings menu
[*] Added the game's logo to the Main Menu
[*] Added a link to the Discord server on the Main Menu
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved mess bar feedback on overlapping messes
[*] Fixed a controller bug when navigating between pause screens
[*] Patched an exploit for multi-step achievement progress
[/list]

[h1]Mobile Release[/h1]
Some people have asked if we will release on mobile, and the answer is...

[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-werecleaner/id6478448519]We already have, and you can play it now on iOS! [/url] This is the entire game, fully playable from start to finish, on your iPhone or iPad! As with the Steam version, the mobile version is totally free without ads.

And for Android users, we're currently testing an Android port! We aren't ready to release quite yet, but we will be conducting a large-scale playtest in our Discord server (hint hint). To release on Google Play, we need 24 testers to play the game, and we'd love your help when we're ready!

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
First of all, we have a roadmap of additions and bonuses that we're already working on:
[list]
[*] Mac release
[*] Android release
[/list]

Beyond this, we are still discussing post release plans. We'll have more details to share in the coming weeks!

See you soon, buds
[b]The WereCleaner Team[/b]
